<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex026012026-11-0612-56-11" status="unreviewed">dang po ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4291">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4291">brang ti</rs></note> na re rtogs pa la mi gsal ba dang | ches gsal ba'i khyad par yod pa yin te | de skad du sang blo brtan gyis chos mchog dang mthong lam
				<lb edRef="inst:4652" n="56a3"/> dang las bu chod pa dang mchod pa lta bu yod pa dang | yang pa chung dang nas rgyas kyis la dang sgra mos chod pa tsam gyi khyad par yod par bshad pa yin pas des mtshon nas bar gyi rnams la 'ang dad la des bar tshad ma chod kyi khyad par yod do zer ro || </seg></TEI>
